opencodeChatSidebar.configuration.title: Chat Sidebar for OpenCode
opencodeChatSidebar.config.serverUrl.mar: Full URL of an already-running opencode server (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4096`). When empty, the extension derives the endpoint from `opencodeChatSidebar.hostname` and `opencodeChatSidebar.port` and may spawn its own managed server.
opencodeChatSidebar.config.port.markdown: Port for the opencode server the extension connects to (and spawns, when `opencodeChatSidebar.autoStartServer` is enabled). Ignored when `opencodeChatSidebar.serverUrl` is set.
opencodeChatSidebar.config.hostname.mark: Hostname for the opencode server the extension connects to (and spawns). Keep `127.0.0.1` unless you know the server binds elsewhere. Ignored when `opencodeChatSidebar.serverUrl` is set.
opencodeChatSidebar.config.binaryPath.ma: Path (or name on `PATH`) of the `opencode` binary used to spawn a managed server.
opencodeChatSidebar.config.serverArgs.ma: Extra arguments appended to `opencode serve --port <port> --hostname <hostname>` when the extension spawns a managed server.
opencodeChatSidebar.config.autoStartServ: When enabled, the extension spawns a managed `opencode serve` process if no healthy server is found on the configured endpoint. Foreign (user-started) servers are only ever attached to, never killed.
opencodeChatSidebar.config.minimumServer: Minimum accepted opencode server version. Servers below this version still run, but the extension shows a warning and hides features the server does not expose. `0.0.0` disables the floor (warn-only).
opencodeChatSidebar.config.debugLogs.mar: Write verbose debug output (with secret redaction) to the "Chat Sidebar for OpenCode" output channel.
opencodeChatSidebar.config.language.mark: Interface language of the panel: `auto` follows VS Code's display language, or pin a locale explicitly. Applies instantly to every open panel.
opencodeChatSidebar.config.chatFontFamil: Font family for chat message rendering in the panel. Empty inherits the VS Code editor font.
Font size (px) for chat message rendering in the panel. `0` inherits the VS Code default.
